rationale.all_gaps_plus_0.25: Increase uncertainty through the 22 gap biases; keep the median weights untouched.
rationale.outer_gaps_plus_0.5: The 95% intervals undercover more than the 50% intervals: expand only gaps outside the central 50% interval.
rationale.outer_gaps_plus_1: A stronger version of the same outer-tail correction, changing only 12 biases per checkpoint.
rationale.calendar_half: Test whether the learned seasonal calendar dominates observed epidemic timing.
rationale.neighbor_half: Test whether messages from nearby states overwhelm local epidemic differences.
rationale.slope_three_quarters: Test excess sensitivity to recent two-week growth in potentially revised observations.
rationale.slope_one_quarter_more: Test the competing explanation of insufficient responsiveness to recent growth.
rationale.acceleration_half: Reduce sensitivity to the noisier second difference while retaining the first difference.
rationale.horizon_four_fifths: Test whether horizon-conditioned extrapolation contributes to longer-horizon errors.
rationale.local_history_one_fifth_more: Increase the target-specific local history contribution relative to shared context before normalization.
